test_cases.description: Verify AssembledContext correctly retrieves and merges RAG knowledge chunks from course textbook, class note, and student remedial scopes.
Verify every contributed chunk and applied instruction records full provenance metadata (scope, author, version, timestamp, content hash).
Verify strict structural separation in prompt assembly: teacher instructions formatted as behavioral directives, RAG chunks as factual reference evidence.
Verify 5-tier teacher instruction resolution hierarchy (SESSION > STUDENT > CLASS > COURSE > ORGANIZATION) overrides broader directives deterministically.
Verify deterministic tie-breaking within same scope level using numerical priority and recency timestamp.
Verify instructions past their expires_at timestamp or marked inactive are excluded from prompt construction.
Verify RAG notes targeting other classes or students are strictly excluded from context generation.
Verify graceful prompt construction when no RAG chunks match the query/concept.
Verify clean prompt generation when no teacher instructions are active for the session/course.
Verify complex multi-scope instruction and RAG chunk integration under realistic multi-tier classroom conditions.
Verify RAG retrieval adheres to course version pinning, preventing leakage from unpublished or different versions.
Verify /api/v1/tutor/turn REST endpoint returns applied instruction IDs, contributed chunk IDs, and full provenance records.
